items.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones

sentences.en: Trump says his D.C.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说他的华盛顿特区

sentences.en: arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones.
sentences.zh: aRCH将作为狙击手和无人机的“军事综合体”。

sentences.en: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统声称，为了保护国家安全，需要在他提议的华盛顿特区凯旋门采取军事行动。

sentences.en: A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.
sentences.zh: 联邦法院正在权衡拱门的合法性。

items.title: Ukraine targets Moscow with hundreds of drones on final day of Russian election

sentences.en: Ukraine targets Moscow with hundreds of drones on final day of Russian election.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯大选的最后一天，乌克兰用数百架无人机瞄准莫斯科。

sentences.en: At least three people killed and oil refinery damaged as doubts cast over initial reports of ballistic missile use Ukraine has targeted Moscow and the surrounding region in a large-scale attack that involved hundreds of drones.
sentences.zh: 至少有三人死亡，炼油厂受损，因为对最初使用弹道导弹的报道表示怀疑，乌克兰在一次涉及数百架无人驾驶飞机的大规模袭击中瞄准了莫斯科和周边地区。

sentences.en: The attack killed at least three people and damaged what Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said was one of Russia’s “key oil industry facilities” on the final day of the country’s parliamentary elections , authorities said on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 当局周日表示，这次袭击造成至少3人死亡，并破坏了乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelenskyy ）在该国议会选举最后一天所说的俄罗斯“关键石油工业设施”之一。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk

sentences.en: PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk.
sentences.zh: 照片：渔民岌岌可危的生活。

sentences.en: In the bustling heart of the southern Indian city of Chennai is a market that never sleeps, where residents from the poorest neighborhoods wage a battle of survival with the sea.
sentences.zh: 在印度南部城市钦奈繁华的心脏地带，有一个永不休息的市场，来自最贫穷社区的居民与大海展开生存之战。

items.title: Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general

sentences.en: Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·巴切莱特退出竞选成为联合国秘书长。

sentences.en: Former president of Chile drops out after support collapsed in security council straw poll, leaving seven candidates in contest Michelle Bachelet, a former president of Chile, has withdrawn her candidacy to become the next secretary general of the ⁠UN, ending an attempt ​that had struggled to gain traction among security council members.
sentences.zh: 智利前总统米歇尔·巴切莱特（ Michelle Bachelet ）在安理会稻草民意调查中支持率崩溃后退出，在竞选中留下了七名候选人，智利前总统米歇尔·巴切莱特（ Michelle Bachelet ）已退出竞选，成为下一任联合国秘书长，结束了努力在安理会成员中获得牵引力的尝试。

sentences.en: Bachelet, 74, announced ⁠her decision in a video posted on Instagram on Saturday, saying: “I will now continue, with the ⁠same determination as always, my international work.” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 74岁的巴切莱特周六在Instagram上发布的一段视频中宣布了她的决定，他说： “我现在将一如既往地以同样的决心继续我的国际工作。”继续阅读。

items.title: ‘I have nothing in the UK at all’: British man torn from his Swedish wife and home

sentences.en: ‘I have nothing in the UK at all’: British man torn from his Swedish wife and home.
sentences.zh: “我在英国一无所有” ：英国男子从他的瑞典妻子和家中被撕裂。

sentences.en: Charles lands at Heathrow with just two bags and nowhere to go as a result of Brexit and Stockholm’s hardline immigration position Doubled over a Heathrow baggage trolley, the former British business director is sobbing uncontrollably, exhausted emotionally and physically after being deported from Sweden.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯只带着两个行李降落在希思罗机场，由于英国脱欧和斯德哥尔摩的强硬移民立场，这位前英国业务总监在希思罗机场的行李手推车上加倍了，在被瑞典驱逐出境后，他无法控制地哭泣，情绪和身体都筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: Hours earlier the 65-year-old had been marched on to a plane in Stockholm, separated from his home and his Swedish wife after a five-year battle to stay in the country after Brexit came to an end.
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，这位65岁的老人被带到斯德哥尔摩的一架飞机上，在英国退欧结束后，经过五年的战斗，他与自己的家和瑞典妻子分开。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right

sentences.en: The right to development: Why equity, not charity, is a human right.
sentences.zh: 发展权：为什么公平而非慈善是一项人权。

sentences.en: Compare two children born in the same year: one in a country with functioning schools, social services, fair elections and a dynamic economy and the other in a nation devastated by poverty, conflict, climate change or corruption.
sentences.zh: 比较同一年出生的两个孩子：一个出生在学校、社会服务、公平选举和经济充满活力的国家，另一个出生在贫穷、冲突、气候变化或腐败肆虐的国家。

items.title: In New Orleans, an empty building becomes a free store — and roller skating rink

sentences.en: In New Orleans, an empty building becomes a free store — and roller skating rink.
sentences.zh: 在新奥尔良，一栋空荡荡的建筑变成了免费商店和溜冰场。

sentences.en: In the Lower Ninth Ward, an old Family Dollar stands covered in graffiti.
sentences.zh: 在下九区（ Lower Ninth Ward ） ，一座旧的Family Dollar矗立着涂鸦。

sentences.en: It looks abandoned.
sentences.zh: 它看起来被遗弃了。

sentences.en: But inside, it's a treasure trove — clothing, home goods, toys and books.
sentences.zh: 但在里面，它是一个宝库—服装，家居用品，玩具和书籍。

sentences.en: And everything is free.
sentences.zh: 一切都是免费的。

sentences.zh: 莫斯科市长说，有450架无人机在隔夜袭击中被击落，其中两人死亡。

must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

items.title: U.S. childcare costs are astronomical. More families are turning to grandparents

sentences.en: U.S. childcare costs are astronomical.
sentences.zh: 美国的儿童保育费用是天文数字。

sentences.en: More families are turning to grandparents.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的家庭转向祖父母。

sentences.en: Grandparents taking care of their grandkids is nothing new.
sentences.zh: 祖父母照顾孙子孙女并不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: But the surging cost of childcare in the U.S. has made familial support even more critical for some parents who struggle to afford it.
sentences.zh: 但是，美国儿童保育费用的飙升使得家庭支持对于一些难以负担的家长来说更加重要。

sentences.en: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰向俄罗斯发射了1000多架无人机，其中包括数百架在莫斯科发射的无人机。

sentences.en: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.
sentences.zh: 莫斯科市长将无人机浪潮描述为对俄罗斯首都的“有史以来最大规模”的袭击，并表示莫斯科的一家炼油厂和一栋住宅楼遭到破坏。

sentences.en: Students: It's time to turn on the mic and hit 'record.'
sentences.zh: 学生：是时候打开麦克风并点击“录音”了。

items.title: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development

sentences.en: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development.
sentences.zh: 为什么中国正在推翻美国对人工智能快速发展的警告。

sentences.en: Beijing believes slowdown calls aim to lock in US advantage, and is pursuing a different balance between safety and pace China bogeyman looms large over American firms’ AI doomsday scenario About two years ago, education entrepreneur Boris But had what he calls a “penny-drop moment” – that, like countless others in China, his company needed to embrace AI before it was made obsolete by it.
sentences.zh: 北京方面认为，放缓通话旨在锁定美国的优势，并且正在寻求安全与步伐之间的不同平衡中国怪兽在美国公司的人工智能末日情景中大显身手大约两年前，教育企业家鲍里斯（ Boris ）有一个他所谓的“一分钱一滴的时刻” --就像中国无数其他人一样，他的公司需要在人工智能被淘汰之前接受它。

sentences.en: His clients, well-off parents looking to send their children to study overseas, had begun arriving in his office reeling off information and opinions gleaned not from rival firms, but from chatbots.
sentences.zh: 他的客户是希望送孩子出国留学的富裕父母，他们已经开始来到他的办公室，他们收集的信息和意见不是来自竞争对手公司，而是来自聊天机器人。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

sentences.en: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy.
sentences.zh: 自Macklemore争议以来， Ed Sheeran在第一场演出中承认了“错误”。

sentences.en: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.
sentences.zh: 在Macklemore因在舞台上发表亲巴勒斯坦言论而退出巡演后，这位歌手谈到了以色列和加沙。

items.title: Thick smoke seen near Riyadh airport as Houthis claim attack on Saudi capital

sentences.en: Thick smoke seen near Riyadh airport as Houthis claim attack on Saudi capital.
sentences.zh: 在利雅得机场附近看到浓烟，胡塞武装声称袭击了沙特首都。

sentences.en: Authorities issued warnings for city in first such alerts for Riyadh since fighting with Iran-backed Houthis escalated in July Yemen’s Houthis said they attacked “sensitive” sites in the Saudi capital with missiles and drones, hours after flames and a large plume of black smoke were seen rising above Riyadh airport on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 自从7月份也门胡塞武装与伊朗支持的胡塞武装作战升级以来，当局首次向利雅得发出警告，称他们用导弹和无人机袭击了沙特首都的“敏感”地点，此前几个小时，利雅得机场上空出现了火焰和大量黑烟。

sentences.en: The Saudi government sent air raid alerts to citizens by phone overnight warning of aerial attacks, marking the first time the government has issued such alerts for Riyadh since fighting with the Iran-backed Houthis escalated in July.
sentences.zh: 沙特政府夜间通过电话向公民发出空袭警报，这是自7月份与伊朗支持的胡塞武装作战升级以来，沙特政府首次向利雅得发出此类警报。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles

sentences.en: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装说，他们用弹道导弹袭击了沙特首都。

sentences.en: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.
sentences.zh: 据报道，利雅得机场的一个燃料仓库遭到袭击，导致周六发生延误，因为沙特阿拉伯说它击落了一枚瞄准首都的弹道导弹。

items.title: Cultural treasures are being destroyed worldwide - so why is no-one being punished?

sentences.en: Cultural treasures are being destroyed worldwide - so why is no-one being punished?.
sentences.zh: 全世界的文化瑰宝正在被摧毁--那么，为什么没有人受到惩罚呢？

sentences.en: A cauldron of conflicts is bubbling across the world, with cultural monuments being destroyed.
sentences.zh: 冲突的大锅正在世界各地冒泡，文化遗迹被摧毁。

sentences.en: These people are fighting against it.
sentences.zh: 这些人正在与之作斗争。

sentences.en: Our head teacher was an abuser.

sentences.en: We joined forces to get justice - now we're married.
sentences.zh: 我们联手伸张正义，现在我们结婚了。

sentences.en: Students spent years collecting evidence against their Indonesian principal, before falling in love.
sentences.zh: 在坠入爱河之前，学生们花了数年时间收集不利于印尼校长的证据。

items.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'

sentences.zh: 北约欢迎格陵兰岛协议，因为特朗普表示将给予美国“永久安全控制权”。

sentences.en: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）数月威胁要吞并该领土后，丹麦和美国已达成协议。

items.title: Trump says US will form 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar

sentences.en: Trump says US will form 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar.
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示，美国将组建“人工智能部队”并任命一名人工智能沙皇。

sentences.en: The president said his administration "will not in any way hinder or stifle the growth" amid amid warnings about the emergent technology.
sentences.zh: 总统表示，在对新兴技术的警告中，他的政府“不会以任何方式阻碍或扼杀增长”。

items.title: Israeli president pardons combat medic who shot dead wounded Palestinian attacker

sentences.en: Israeli president pardons combat medic who shot dead wounded Palestinian attacker.
sentences.zh: 以色列总统赦免开枪打死受伤巴勒斯坦袭击者的医务人员。

sentences.en: Elor Azaria’s conviction in 2017 for manslaughter of man who stabbed soldier continues to divide country Israel’s president has pardoned a combat medic who shot dead a badly wounded Palestinian attacker who had stabbed a soldier in the occupied West Bank, in a case that divided the country a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 2017年，埃洛尔·阿扎里亚（ Elor Azaria ）因过失杀害刺伤士兵的人而被定罪，这继续分裂以色列总统赦免了一名战斗医生，这名医生在十年前分裂该国的情况下，枪杀了一名在被占领的约旦河西岸刺伤一名士兵的巴勒斯坦袭击者。

sentences.en: Elor Azaria’s conviction in 2017 for manslaughter and his release after serving two-thirds of his 18-month sentence drew enormous attention in Israel, where military service is compulsory for most Jewish men.
sentences.zh: 2017年，埃洛尔·阿扎里亚（ Elor Azaria ）因过失杀人罪被定罪，并在服刑18个月的三分之二后获释，这在以色列引起了极大的关注，大多数犹太男子都必须服兵役。

items.title: Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets

sentences.en: Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普禁止一些媒体后，记者拒绝白宫进入。

sentences.en: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters' White House press badges were confiscated, the outlets reported.
sentences.zh: 据报道， CNN、MS NOW和Politico记者的白宫记者证被没收。
